description: Original, AI-assisted phrase banks for Small Weather. Source poems are conceptual inspiration, never runtime input.

turn: I came here to leave something behind.
For once, I have nothing to ask.
I thought that leaving would be louder.
Perhaps this is how a place forgives.
I stay until my hurry comes apart.
title: What the {motif} keeps
{weather} / {motif}
A place for {weather}
The patience of the {motif}
After the {weather}

rain.label: City / waiting
places: at the end of our street
sounds: a tram bell trembles down the street
a gutter hums above the doorway
a loose sign taps against the wall
details: one lit window floats inside a puddle
the pavement wears a second sky
a paper cup fills slowly with the dark
the crossing changes colour for no one
counterpoints: the street keeps making room for footsteps
the puddles hold their borrowed light
another window opens to the weather
the gutter carries on without an answer
endings: Somewhere, a door is drying in its frame
The last light takes the long way home
A little water travels on without me
Tomorrow waits beneath the peeling paint

tide.label: Harbour / release
places: at the edge of the boatyard
sounds: a chain knocks softly on the stone
a gull calls once beyond the boats
a loose halyard rings against a mast
details: the tide erases one more waterline
a strip of sky lies caught between the boats
salt blooms along the seam of every plank
the harbour turns its pockets inside out
counterpoints: the water keeps returning what it can
the shore makes room for one more wave
the tide has never learned to hold a grudge
a boat turns slowly towards the open water
endings: The shore remains, though nothing here stands still
One small wave arrives with empty hands
The distance leaves a little salt behind
Beyond the pier, the water starts again

frost.label: Garden / return
sounds: a blackbird tests the quiet with one note
a latch clicks softly in the morning air
a branch taps once against the greenhouse
gravel shifts beneath a careful foot
details: each blade of grass carries a little glass
the soil keeps all its letters underground
a leaf holds still beneath its coat of white
the greenhouse keeps a thumbprint of the sun
counterpoints: a green shoot lifts the edge of winter
the roots have kept a different calendar
a patch of earth begins to show its colour
the light returns without an explanation
endings: Under the path, a root goes on deciding
By noon, the smallest drop will find the soil
A little warmth is working out of sight
The garden keeps a space for what comes next
